blurb: The streetlights here never went out, so people moved in under them and stayed.
name: The Filaments
signature: A streetlight hums overhead, burning steady, the way it has since before anyone here was born.
Washing hangs across a gap between two walls, stiff with cold and not quite dry.
Somebody's radio leaks down through a floor, tuned between two stations and left there.
The smell of boiled onions comes up out of a basement grate and hangs about at head height.
A front door goes, and three others further down the terrace answer it within the minute.
skyline: Halcyon Towers stands over the rooftops with its back turned
